The path is more memory-bandwidth-bound; reducing data movement/representation cost may help more than extra FLOPS
The model must be CPU-bound
DNS must be the only bottleneck

en-US.explanation: Performance is limited by the saturated resource. If memory bandwidth is full while arithmetic units are not, more peak compute does not solve the data-supply bottleneck.

distractor_explanations.D: DNS is not inherently tied to an internal GPU decoding bandwidth bottleneck.
distractor_explanations.A: Roofline-style reasoning shows workloads can be bandwidth-bound rather than FLOP-bound.
distractor_explanations.C: The evidence points to GPU memory bandwidth, not necessarily CPU.

en-US.takeaway: Identify compute-bound versus memory-bound behavior before choosing an optimization.
